## FAQ

### Who is the new CEO of CTS (NYSE: CTS) in 2026?

CTS named **Pratik Trivedi** , its current COO, as CEO and President effective July 6, 2026. According to CTS, Trivedi will also join the Board when his CEO appointment becomes effective, succeeding long-time CEO Kieran O’Sullivan.

### When will Pratik Trivedi officially become CEO and President of CTS (CTS)?

Pratik Trivedi will become CEO and President of CTS on **July 6, 2026** . According to CTS, he will transition from his current COO role and simultaneously join the company’s Board of Directors on that effective date.

### What role will former CEO Kieran O’Sullivan have at CTS after July 2026?
Kieran O’Sullivan will serve as **Executive Chair** and remain on the CTS Board after July 2026. According to CTS, he transitions to this position following 14 years as CEO, during which the company reports strengthened market position and higher enterprise value.

### What experience does new CTS (CTS) CEO Pratik Trivedi bring to the role?

Pratik Trivedi brings experience in high-growth technology companies, including CTS, Eaton and Cummins. According to CTS, he has a mechanical engineering degree, a master’s in industrial engineering, and an MBA, and is recognized for execution, strategic leadership and sustained results as COO.

### How was the CTS CEO succession plan for Pratik Trivedi developed?

CTS describes Trivedi’s appointment as the outcome of a focused, two-year succession planning effort. According to CTS, the Board conducted this process to position the company for continued long-term success and unanimously selected Trivedi based on his performance as COO.

# CTS Corporation Names Pratik Trivedi New CEO, Announces Leadership Changes

Share

Scoop Thompson 🤖 June 25, 2026

### CTS Corporation Announces CEO Transition and Leadership Changes

CTS Corporation revealed a significant leadership transition with its current President and CEO, Kieran O’Sullivan, stepping down from the CEO role effective July 6, 2026. Mr. O’Sullivan will remain actively involved with the company as Executive Chairman of the Board. Concurrently, the company appointed Pratik Trivedi as the new President and CEO, marking a key management change aimed at continuing CTS’s strategic direction.

This leadership reshuffle reflects a planned succession, with Mr. O’Sullivan shifting to a governance and advisory role while Mr. Trivedi takes on full operational leadership. The company also expanded its Board of Directors from eight to nine members to accommodate Mr. Trivedi’s addition.

* * *

### Key Details

**Leadership Transition and Board Changes:**
* Kieran O’Sullivan will step down as President and CEO on July 6, 2026, but will remain on the Board as Executive Chairman starting the same date.
* Pratik Trivedi will assume the roles of President and CEO effective July 6, 2026.
* The Board of Directors will increase from eight to nine members with Mr. Trivedi joining as a director.

**Background on Pratik Trivedi:**

* Age 47, Mr. Trivedi has been CTS’s Chief Operating Officer since December 2025.
* He joined CTS in April 2024 as Senior Vice President.
* Prior to CTS, he was Vice President, North America for Eaton Corporation’s mobility business since 2017.
* He also held several leadership roles at Cummins, Inc., a global power management company.
* There are no familial or special arrangements influencing his appointment, and he has no material related-party transactions with CTS.

**Compensation and Incentives for Pratik Trivedi:**

* Annual base salary set at $675,000.

# CTS Promotes COO Pratik Trivedi To President And CEO

By [RTTNews Staff Writer](https://www.rttnews.com/author/staff-writer.
aspx) [✉](mailto:editorial@rttnews.com) | Published: 6/25/2026 8:21 AM ET | [Follow Us](https://news.google.com/publications/CAAqBwgKMNGQnQsw4pq1Aw?hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN%3Aen) | [Join Us](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbCqNxTElagsrOpyrZ2j)

CTS Corp. ( [CTS](https://www.rttnews.com/SymbolSearch.aspx?Symbol=CTS) ) announced Thursday that its Board of Directors has promoted Pratik Trivedi, CTS' current COO, to Chief Executive Officer and President effective July 6, 2026.

Trivedi will succeed Kieran O'Sullivan, who will remain on the Board and serve as Executive Chair. He will also become a member of the Board when his appointment as CEO becomes effective.

Trivedi brings a wealth of experience in high-growth [technology](https://www.rttnews.com/) companies, including CTS, Eaton and Cummins.
Trivedi joined CTS on April 2024 as Senior Vice President, Advanced Materials and Solutions and was appointed Chief Operating Officer effective December 5, 2025. From 2017 until joining CTS, Trivedi served as Vice President, North America for the mobility [business](https://www.rttnews.com/Content/Business.aspx) of Eaton Corp.

| |
